content_data.meeting_title: Q3 Global Sales Strategy Review & Optimization
agenda_items: Resource allocation for upcoming peak travel season initiatives
Analysis of customer feedback trends and impact on retention rates
Discussion on new product offering 'VoyageConnect' launch strategy and sales enablement needs
Competitive landscape update for luxury travel segment
Review of current sales performance against targets for key regions (APAC, EMEA, Americas)
key_decisions: Implement new CRM integration for improved lead tracking and conversion analytics by next quarter.
Form cross-functional task force to address recurring customer service pain points identified in recent surveys.
Allocate additional marketing budget to digital campaigns targeting underserved segments in EMEA.
